findings.claim: Preserve or explicitly reject masked inputs before array coercion. np.asarray silently discards a MaskedArray mask, allowing an excluded pixel to be published as a valid measurement.
findings.evidence: Static trace: decode_linear(np.ma.array([100.0], mask=[True]), nodata=None) loses its mask at line 180. Classification at lines 234-242 sees only positive finite DN, and lines 293-296 produce finite power with VALID/NONE. The same conversion serves decode_db, x_power, and angle_to_degrees. No mask handling or rejection exists in the module or tests. This violates PRD.md:415 and CLAUDE.md's requirement to preserve masks.
